summary: Smart Suggestions + Enterprise/Firms contact panel tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 10/10 passing — auth, /all shape, /client/{id} shape, 404 on bogus id, user isolation (both /all empty + /client 404), and rule firings (no_docs/no_compliance/no_touchpoint for admin client, no_portfolio_review with seeded doc, stale_review + outdated_products with backdated portfolio review, all_good fallback when all 4 collections seeded). Frontend verified via Playwright: Pricing enterprise-panel + mailto button correct, /clients renders suggestions-{client_id} group with 3 badges for admin's empty client, Client 360 renders suggestions-panel with 3 priority-coded rows (MEDIUM, MEDIUM, LOW).
critical_code_review_comments: smart_suggestions.py rules are deterministic, _id excluded via projection, all queries scoped by advisor_id+client_id — correct isolation, no ObjectId leakage.
_months_since handles tz-naive ISO strings by defaulting to UTC — robust.
Frontend Client360 hides suggestions-panel when only 'all_good' present (kind check on suggestions[0]) — correct.

Frontend ClientsPage shows ALL suggestions including all_good as a green checkmark badge — acceptable UX; consider hiding all_good from list badges too for visual consistency with C360 (currently 'all_good' would render as '✓ All up to date' in green which is fine).
ClientsPage suggestions fetch is non-blocking (try/catch swallow) — won't break the page if endpoint errors. Good.
PricingPage enterprise-panel uses correct mailto href: mailto:pierrelouisvdm@gmail.com?subject=Firm%20Licensing%20Enquiry — verified live.
test_credentials: Admin: pierrelouisvdm@gmail.com / Scorpio@57!! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Ephemeral advisors created on the fly per pytest run (sm_adv_<ts>_<rand>@example.com / Passw0rd!).
seed_data_creation: Tests insert + clean up: document_analyses, portfolio_reviews (one with old created_at + outdated_product_warnings), compliance_records, advisor_emails — all delete_many'd by client_id after each test. Ephemeral clients created via POST /api/clients and DELETEd at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_smart_suggestions.py covers all 7 rule kinds (no_docs, no_portfolio_review, stale_review, outdated_products, no_compliance, no_touchpoint, all_good) + auth + isolation. Direct mongo seeding used because there is no public API to insert portfolio_reviews with arbitrary created_at — uses MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env. Frontend was tested by seeding localStorage keys 'advisorypro_token' and 'advisorypro_user' (same pattern as iteration_27).
